notes.title: Community Update Out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25345916/c98581ddb652ad823cfa756a0aa27c79e9fc552d.png[/img]
Hello Everyone!

We have just pushed out our in-game level editor as well as Steam Workshop access to share your level creations! 

We will continue to add more and fix up the editor as time goes on, but we will do our best not to ruin any of the created files in the meantime.

We are interested in what you will come up with, and keep an eye out for our next major update!

Cheers,

Two Man Army Games
